newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Feb 26.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- President Jiang Zemin delivers a lengthy eulogy at the memorial service for the late Deng Xiaoping.
- Full text of Jiang Zemin's memorial speech.
- An editorial laments the passing of Deng Xiaoping and pledges to carry on Deng's cause.
- Excerpt of an ode to Deng Xiaoping.
- Beijing residents line the streets outside the Great Hall of the People holding banners expressing grief over the loss of Deng Xiaoping.
- The Chongqing branch of the China Everbright Bank wins approval to conduct foreign exchange business.
- The investment and trust company under the China Construction Bank adopts the new name of China Xingda Trust and Investment Co but ties to the bank remain unchanged.
- China's insurance premium incomes are seen at 270 billion yuan a year by 2000.
- China aims to eliminate the use of incandescent lamps by the year 2000 to try to save energy.
- Crude oil ouput of the Bohai Oil Co is seen hitting 4.5 million tonnes by the year 2000.
